verdict.rationale: OpenAI documents a hosted, self-serve fine-tuning path. There are guides for supervised fine-tuning, which trains an OpenAI model on your own examples, and for reinforcement fine-tuning of reasoning models, and the pricing page publishes fine-tuning prices without any sales contact. missing for 10: details on which models are tunable and the job/data-upload workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration of the fine-tuning process.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can fine-tune the vendor's models on my own data through a documented self-serve path — hosted fine-tuning API or tunable open weights

citations.quote: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) lets you train an OpenAI model with examples for your specific use case.
Reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) adapts an OpenAI reasoning model with a feedback signal you define.
plus batch and fine-tuning price sections
